name: PM-Kisan Samman Nidhi
benefit: ₹6,000 per year paid in three equal four-monthly installments directly into bank accounts via DBT.

eligibility.landHolding: Must hold cultivable land in applicant's name
exclusions: Income tax payers from previous assessment year

documentsRequired: Bank Account linked with Aadhaar & NPCI DBT enabled
Mobile number linked with Aadhaar for e-KYC
applicationProcess: Visit pmkisan.gov.in and click on 'New Farmer Registration'.
Enter Aadhaar number and select state, then verify via Aadhaar OTP.
Fill land record details (Khasra/Khata number) and upload land ownership proof.
Submit and complete mandatory e-KYC using biometrics or facial recognition / OTP.

name: Ayushman Bharat – PMJAY
hindiName: आयुष्मान भारत - प्रधानमंत्री जन आरोग्य योजना
ministry: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
benefit: Cashless secondary and tertiary health cover up to ₹5 Lakh per eligible family per year across 27,000+ empaneled hospitals.

eligibility.criteria: Deprivation criteria under SECC 2011 (Socio-Economic Caste Census), NFSA Ration Card holders, or all Senior Citizens aged 70+ irrespective of income.

documentsRequired: Age proof for Senior Citizen (70+) scheme extension
applicationProcess: Check eligibility at beneficiary.nha.gov.in using Aadhaar or Ration Card number.
Visit nearest Common Service Centre (CSC) or empaneled government/private hospital Ayushman Mitra desk.
Complete biometric e-KYC verification.
Download Ayushman Card (Golden Card) from the portal.

name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana (PMAY - Gramin & Urban)
ministry: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs & Ministry of Rural Development
targetGroup: Homeless families or families living in kutcha/dilapidated houses
benefit: Financial assistance of ₹1.20 Lakh (plains) to ₹1.30 Lakh (hilly states) in rural areas; interest subsidy up to ₹2.67 Lakh under CLSS in urban areas.

eligibility.gender: Any (Preference to female ownership or co-ownership)
eligibility.criteria: Family must not own a pucca house anywhere in India.

documentsRequired: Aadhaar Card of all family members
Bank Account passbook linked to Aadhaar
Income Certificate / BPL Certificate / SECC TIN number
Affidavit of not owning a pucca house
Land ownership document (for construction on own plot)
applicationProcess: For Gramin: Gram Sabha finalizes eligible list; registration done by Block Development Officer / Panchayat Secretary.
For Urban: Apply online at pmaymis.gov.in under 'Citizen Assessment' or through local municipal corporation / CSC center.
Geo-tagging of construction phases is conducted before installment disbursements.

name: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana (SSY)
ministry: Ministry of Finance (Beti Bachao Beti Padhao initiative)
targetGroup: Parents / Legal Guardians of girl children
benefit: High sovereign-backed interest rate (typically 8.2% p.a.), tax exemptions under 80C, and tax-free maturity value for higher education and marriage.

eligibility.criteria: Account opened before child attains 10 years of age. Max 2 accounts per family (exceptions for twins/triplets).

documentsRequired: Aadhaar Card & PAN Card of Parent/Guardian
applicationProcess: Visit any Post Office or authorized commercial bank branch.
Fill the SSY Account Opening Form (Form-1).
Deposit initial minimum amount of ₹250 (up to ₹1.5 Lakh per financial year).
Receive passbook for the account.

name: Pradhan Mantri MUDRA Yojana (PMMY)
targetGroup: Micro-entrepreneurs, small shopkeepers, artisans, small business owners
benefit: Collateral-free business loans: Shishu (up to ₹50,000), Kishore (₹50,001 to ₹5 Lakh), Tarun (₹5 Lakh to ₹10 Lakh), and Tarun Plus (up to ₹20 Lakh).
documentsRequired: Business Address Proof & Registration / Udyam Certificate
applicationProcess: Apply online via UdyamiMitra portal (udyamimitra.in) or visit any commercial / rural bank.
Submit application with project proposal and required documents.
Bank sanctions collateral-free loan based on viability.

name: Atal Pension Yojana (APY)
benefit: Guaranteed monthly pension between ₹1,000 to ₹5,000 upon reaching 60 years of age, depending on contribution amount and age of joining.

eligibility.criteria: Indian citizen aged 18 to 40 years holding a savings bank account. Must not be an income taxpayer.

documentsRequired: Savings Bank Account with Auto-Debit mandate
applicationProcess: Approach your bank branch where savings account is maintained.
Submit APY registration form with auto-debit consent.
Receive PRAN (Permanent Retirement Account Number) card confirmation.

name: PM Vishwakarma Scheme
ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (MSME)
targetGroup: Traditional artisans and craftspeople (carpenters, blacksmiths, potters, cobblers, tailors, etc.)
benefit: PM Vishwakarma Certificate & ID card, skill training with ₹500/day stipend, ₹15,000 toolkit incentive, and collateral-free enterprise credit up to ₹3 Lakh at 5% concessional interest rate.

eligibility.criteria: Individual working with hands and tools in one of 18 designated family-based traditional trades.

documentsRequired: Active Mobile number linked to Aadhaar
applicationProcess: Register at nearest Common Services Centre (CSC) with biometric authentication.
Three-tier verification (Gram Panchayat / ULB, District Screening, Screening Committee).
Attend basic training and receive toolkit voucher and loan eligibility.

name: PM Street Vendor's AtmaNirbhar Nidhi (PM SVANidhi)
ministry: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
benefit: Working capital loan starting at ₹10,000 (1st tranche), ₹20,000 (2nd tranche), up to ₹50,000 (3rd tranche) with 7% interest subsidy and cashback on digital transactions.

eligibility.criteria: Vendors possessing Certificate of Vending / ID card issued by Urban Local Bodies (ULBs) or Recommendation Letter.

documentsRequired: Vending Certificate / Identity Card / Letter of Recommendation from ULB/Town Vending Committee
applicationProcess: Apply through pmsvanidhi.mohua.gov.in or PM SVANidhi mobile app.
Can also apply via CSC or Banking Correspondent (BC).
Direct disbursement into bank account upon verification.

name: Tele-Law: Mainstreaming Legal Aid to the Marginalized
ministry: Ministry of Law and Justice & NALSA
targetGroup: Women, children, SC/ST, victims of trafficking, disabled persons, and low-income citizens
benefit: Free video/telephonic legal consultation with panel lawyers through Common Service Centers (CSCs) or Tele-Law mobile app.

eligibility.criteria: Free for persons eligible under Section 12 of Legal Services Authorities Act (Women, Children, SC/ST, disabled, disaster victims, persons earning below state prescribed threshold).

documentsRequired: Income proof / Category proof (if seeking free advice under Section 12)
applicationProcess: Visit any Common Service Center (CSC) or download 'Tele-Law Beneficiary' app from Google Play Store.
Register details, select dispute category, and book appointment slot.
Receive consultation call/video from assigned panel lawyer from District Legal Services Authority (DLSA).

name: Mukhyamantri Mahila Kalyan / Ladli Behna Schemes (State Specific)
hindiName: मुख्यमंत्री लाड़ली बहना / महिला कल्याण योजना
ministry: State Departments of Women & Child Development (MP, MH, etc.)
targetGroup: Married, widowed, divorced, and deserted women
benefit: Direct monthly financial support (₹1,250 - ₹1,500/month) transferred directly to women's bank accounts.

eligibility.state: State Specific (e.g. MP, Maharashtra Majhi Ladki Bahin)
eligibility.criteria: Resident of the state, family income less than ₹2.5 Lakh/year, not an income taxpayer or government employee.

documentsRequired: Individual Bank Account (Single, DBT & Aadhaar enabled)
applicationProcess: Camp-based application organized at Gram Panchayat or Ward level.
Biometric e-KYC and form verification.
Monthly DBT credit upon approval.
